name: Moomoo.io
author: Addicting Games
description:
Moomoo.io is the ultimate in survive and thrive arena games. It also asks the ultimatae question, the one question we all live with and sturggle with: Are you playing to win or are you playing to get by? You'll find out pretty quick in this fast and fun arena style io game where your choices have consequences and those consequences are a matter of life or death. Do you want to chop down trees to get wood, do you want to smash errant rocks in order to aquire minerals? Are you going to forge weapons to take into the arena later, or build armor to protect yourself from the savage hordes? The choice is up to you but you better make it quick!  You'll be surrounded by dozens of other real life players. Not just non player characters but flesh and blood opponents who want the same thing as you, and you better believe they're optimizing their stats, sharpening their swords and looking for fresh faced newbs to decimate on their road to the top!

Just like in real life, the leaderboard does not lie. Youo can not charm your way up it, you can not lie yoour way up it, you can't be born number one and no one can give it to you. If you want to be number one you'll have to earn it. You'll have to prove your worth in battle against an army of faceless hordes just like you!
